source: Map geometry: MapChart.net (CC BY-SA 4.0), based on Hearts of Iron IV by Paradox Interactive.

projection.note: lon=(x-780)*0.05, lat=(y-480)*0.05. Display is flat pixel space. The regional fit is only for 1914 owner sampling.

rejectedNames.reason: TGWR 756-Jiuquan.txt is an Ottoman province with a Bulgarian core, not Gansu.
TGWR 754-Golog.txt is Kufra in Libya, not the Amdo plateau.
TGWR 746-Ordos.txt is a British coastal enclave with a naval base, not Ordos.
TGWR 752-Chamdo.txt is Loango in French Congo, not Tibetan Chamdo.
TGWR 1021-Acre.txt is Ottoman Acre. MapChart Acre is the Brazilian territory.
